async get_current_user(token: str = Depends(dependency=<fastapi.security.oauth2.OAuth2PasswordBearer object>, use_cache=True, scope=None), db: AsyncSession = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None))[source]¶

Return the currently authenticated user from an access token.

The decoded user is loaded from Redis when available. On a cache miss, the user is retrieved from the database and stored in Redis temporarily.

Parameters:

  • token – OAuth2 access token.

  • db – Asynchronous database session.

Returns:

Authenticated user.

Raises:

HTTPException – If the token or user cannot be validated.

Email service¶

async src.services.email.send_email(email: EmailStr, username: str, host: str)[source]¶

Send an email verification message to a user.

A temporary JWT verification token is generated and included in the verification email template.

Parameters:

  • email – Recipient email address.

  • username – Recipient user name.

  • host – Base URL of the application.

Returns:

None.
